messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Eli Turner <eli@fintechco.com>
Date: 2027-02-10T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Data retention exception request — FinTechCo / Redwood

Hi Eli,

Great to meet on the call today — thanks for walking through FinTechCo's data and compliance needs. Quick recap and next steps so we're aligned: 

- Requirement: No retention of end-customer PII or transaction-level content (effectively 0-retention for request bodies).
- Logging: FinTechCo will accept short-lived operational logs, but needs a maximum 7-day retention window for request metadata (no request payloads).
- Embeddings & derived data: must be treated as regulated; request explicit opt-out or separate retention schedule.
- Data residency: US-only (us-east-1) and customer-managed KMS for encrypted at-rest storage.
- Controls: SOC 2 evidence, audit logs, and access review required during procurement.

Action items I propose:
1) We draft a retention-exception proposal (DPA addendum + retention schedule) and share security artifacts.
2) Security review (internal) and sign-off on the exception form.
3) Agree on a short pilot / PoC timeline (2-4 weeks) while legal finalizes the addendum.

I attached my quick discovery notes from today's call. If I missed anything, flag it and I'll update.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
(650) 555-0198

Camila,

Thanks for the clear recap — that aligns with our ask. A few clarifications from our side:

- 0-retention must apply to any payloads that contain cardholder or customer-identifying fields (PII).
- We can accept aggregated metrics / telemetry but only if there is no possibility to reconstruct individual requests.
- For embeddings: we need an option to opt-out of storing embeddings entirely; if embeddings are required for functionality, retention should be <= 30 days behind an approval process.
- Our procurement timeline is tight; we'd like a proposed addendum this week so legal can review.

Can Redwood provide the following by EOD Friday?
1) Draft retention-exception form / DPA addendum text (redlined if possible).
2) SOC 2 snapshot and the KMS integration notes.
3) A proposed technical approach for ensuring 0-retention (e.g., a no-logging proxy or immediate in-memory processing pipeline).

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Eli

Camila / Rafael,

Thanks for the context. Security and Legal have looked at similar requests — here's a pragmatic proposal we can offer to keep the deal moving while protecting both parties:

Proposal (high level):
- PII payloads: offer a configurable "no-logging" (zero retention) mode at the route level for FinTechCo. When enabled, request bodies are not persisted; processing occurs in-memory and ephemeral logs scrub payloads immediately.
- Metadata / operational logs: allow up to 7 days retention for request metadata (timestamps, route, aggregate latency metrics) with stricter access controls and RBAC.
- Embeddings: provide an explicit opt-out flag at the API level to prevent embeddings from being stored. If customer requires embeddings for features, default retention = 30 days and require a signed exception form.
- Data residency: commit to US-only storage for FinTechCo customer data in a dedicated tenant; support customer-managed KMS for encryption keys.
- Audit & evidence: provide SOC 2 Type II snapshot and an assurance letter; provide an audit log export process under NDA.

Docs attached: retention-exception-form.pdf (fills in fields for approval), and a proposed DPA addendum (redwood-dpa-addendum-v1.pdf). I also placed a Docusign envelope link placeholder in the related links so legal can route.

Operational notes: security needs up to 3 business days to configure tenant-level flags and enable the no-logging mode for a pilot. Legal may need 5-7 business days to complete DPA redline. Given FinTechCo's timeline, we can offer the pilot while legal finalizes documentation.

Next steps I recommend we send the attached retention-exception-form and DPA addendum (redlined) to FinTechCo, include SOC2 access, and propose a short pilot start next week.

—Marissa
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Eli — thanks for the patience. Per internal review (security + legal) we can support FinTechCo's needs with the following proposed terms: 

1) No-logging mode: We will enable a route-level no-logging configuration that avoids persisting request payloads (0-retention) and processes requests in-memory. This covers PII payloads as requested.
2) Metadata logs: Operational metadata retention limited to 7 days. No payloads are retained in logs.
3) Embeddings: API-level opt-out to prevent embeddings from being stored. If embeddings are required, retention defaults to 30 days and requires a signed exception form.
4) Data residency & keys: US-only storage (us-east-1) and support for customer-managed KMS.
5) Evidence & paperwork: Attached is the retention-exception-form and our DPA addendum (redwood-dpa-addendum-v1.pdf). We can also share SOC 2 evidence via the secure link.

Timeline & next steps:
- Security will enable no-logging pilot within 3 business days of agreement (Marissa's team).
- Legal will circulate redline of the addendum; expected 5 business days to finalize.
- Please sign the retention-exception-form and DPA addendum (we can route via DocuSign).

If that aligns, I'll schedule a 30-minute call with Rafael (engineering) to kick off the technical setup and confirm the onboarding checklist.
